source.document: Nissan service information and collision position statements: Radar Recalibration Post-Repair (NPSB-16-597) and Around View Monitor Calibration (NPSB-16-600).
source.note: Mitsubishi shares service information with Nissan through the Renault-Nissan-Mitsubishi Alliance. Infiniti is Nissan's luxury division and follows Nissan procedures. Nissan vehicles do not use a parking sensor calibration procedure.

general_requirements: Nissan North America states that recalibration in the described repair situations is mandatory, without exception.

components.location: Front of vehicle (Safety Shield Technology front radar)
components.calibration_note: Recalibration is mandatory, without exception. Failure to follow could result in radar malfunction, or vehicle systems including safety features not working as originally intended.
components.trigger_lead: Calibration is required when any repair causes the radar sensor to be:

triggers: Front camera unit is removed and installed
Windshield glass is removed and installed

components.location: Behind the rear bumper, left and right sides
components.calibration_note: Repainting the rear bumper changes paint thickness over the sensor and is a trigger on Nissan — calibration is required even when no removal/replacement occurred.
triggers: Side radar (blind spot) sensor is removed and installed
Side radar (blind spot) sensor is replaced
Rear bumper is removed and installed

components.location: Front grille, rear, and both side mirrors (four cameras)
components.calibration_note: Calibration is mandatory any time a camera or camera mounting part is removed, installed, or replaced. Failure to adhere to this procedure could result in the Around View Monitor system not functioning as originally intended.
components.trigger_lead: Calibration is required when any of the following is removed, installed, or replaced:
triggers: Camera mounting part (front grille, door mirror, or others)

components.trigger_lead: Zero point calibration is required when:
triggers: Vehicle is in for repair after any accident or collision
